exposure.needed: whether operators' scripts or monitoring tools run and parse the output of `cilium-dbg status --verbose` health data

consequence.statement: The cilium-dbg status --verbose command output structure has changed. Health data from non-leaf components now appears under a reporter leaf, and branches are sorted by fully qualified health status identifier. Scripts or monitoring tools that parse this output may need updates to handle the new format.

assertion.statement: The `cilium-dbg status --verbose` command health data may now show health reported on a non-leaf component under a leaf named `reporter`. Health data tree…

evidence.excerpt:
* The `cilium-dbg status --verbose` command health data may now show health reported on a non-leaf
  component under a leaf named `reporter`. Health data tree branches will now also be sorted by
  the fully qualified health status identifier.
